claims.statement: Every avatar exposes a stable accessible identity name independent of image availability.
Presence is a separately announced status and is not communicated by color alone.
Avatar groups announce the number of hidden people through the overflow affordance.

component.purpose: Make identity recognizable, named, and resilient when imagery is unavailable.
component.title: Avatar

states.description: Presence changes enter and exit without moving the identity surface.
Tooltip and Popover add progressive identity context without changing Avatar's core semantics.
Deterministic initials fallback after image failure.
